title: Implement AuditLogger: async writer with buffered writes
description:
Implement AuditLogger: a Tokio task that receives AuditEvent via an mpsc channel and writes them to the audit_log table. Buffered writes: accumulate up to 100 events or 1 second, whichever comes first, then flush in a single transaction. On shutdown, flush remaining events. Artifact: core/src/audit.rs.

Acceptance: events are durable (flushed) before acknowledgment in tests; buffer does not block the caller (channel send is non-blocking with backpressure); on panic, buffered events are flushed via drop; unit test: send 1000 events, verify all written
